_meta.name: English
accounts.addHint: Another Claude Code configuration directory. It is made if it is not there yet.
accounts.addHint2: Sign in new makes a fresh account and starts a session in it to log in. Existing takes a config directory you already have.
accounts.addWhere: Where its configuration lives — ~/.claude4, for instance.
accounts.added: {name} added — sign in to it in the session that just opened.
accounts.label: name
accounts.makeDefaultTip: New sessions start under this account unless another is chosen.
accounts.removeHead: take it out of the list?
accounts.removeKeeps: the directory stays, with everything in it
accounts.removeTip: Take it out of this list. The directory and everything in it stays.
accounts.renameTip: Call it something else. What sessions were recorded under does not change.
agents.copyMade: A copy of your own was made. It applies from now on instead of the built-in one.
agents.deleteTip: Delete this profile of your own — built-in ones stay
agents.explain: A profile teaches plxr to recognise a CLI: which command it is, when it is waiting, when it is working. The built-in ones live in the app; your own go to ~/.plxr/agents and survive every update.
agents.fieldBlocked: Waiting for you when the screen says

agents.fieldMatchHint: One command per line. "claude" also matches "claude --resume".
agents.fieldQuietHint: After this many seconds without new output, the state on the right applies.
agents.fieldWorkingHint: One phrase per line. Anything that shows it is still going.
agents.nameAsk: What is the command called? aider, codex, cursor …
agents.newTip: Start a profile of your own — from a filled template, not an empty page
agents.noneRunning: No running session matches it yet — it takes effect as soon as one does.
agents.originBuiltIn: Built in. Saving makes a copy of your own — the original stays.
agents.originNew: New. It is created when you save.
agents.originOwn: Your own profile. It lives with you and survives every update.
agents.rawTitle: The file as it would be saved
agents.saved: {name} saved — takes effect on the next status update
agents.tryBlocked: Counts as "waiting for you" — because of: {rule}
agents.tryMatch: Recognised as this CLI — because of: {rule}
agents.tryNothing: No rule matches. After the quiet time the setting above decides.
agents.tryPlaceholder: Paste a line from the terminal here

archive.noneHint: Archived Claude Code conversations show up here once there are any.
archive.placeholder: title and project — Return searches the full text
archive.terminalsTip: Search everything that was ever on a terminal
archive.deleteDetail: {title} is removed from disk and cannot be resumed again.
brake.partial: {done} of {total} halted — the rest could not be stopped
branch.dropTip: Remove it. Never one that holds commits nowhere else.
branch.name: name
branch.newFrom: It starts where you are standing now.

changesPanel.followTip: Follows the session that was focused last
changesPanel.noFolder: This is not a folder git knows.

dock.sessionGoneHint: It ended, or plxr was restarted since. Close this panel.
dock.sessionGoneRestart: It ended, or plxr was restarted since. RESTART brings it back under the same id when plxr still knows it; otherwise the archive has the conversation.
empty.agents: claude · codex · opencode · aider · gemini · cursor
empty.explain: Use + NEW to start a CLI in a terminal of its own. It keeps running when you close this window.
empty.hook: Claude Code is not reporting its state yet — settings → agents → ATTACH. Without it a tile only knows what stands on the screen.

Installed. New sessions report their state from now on.
Existing hooks were left untouched.

keys.filesUp: Up one folder in the file tree

notify.title: notifications
